subject: shared is red on biome: apps/web/src/search/search.test.tsx format
body: pnpm exec biome check apps/web fails on origin/claude/naadi-shared (head after 32f4370): apps/web/src/search/search.test.tsx needs formatting (around line 113: 'context: null, anchor: null' must be split onto two lines). Fix: pnpm exec biome check --write apps/web/src/search/search.test.tsx. I have not touched it; my integrate runs biome on my own paths only.
